model.decision_timestamp: exact prior one-minute bar close at entry_ts minus one minute
model.premium_input: prior completed option-bar OHLC close; never the current entry-bar close
model.spot_input: prior completed NIFTY index-bar close; never the current entry-bar close
model.execution_reference: exact entry-timestamp option-bar open if present and OHLC-valid

limitations: Model estimates are not exchange Greeks.
Prior minute-bar closes are model inputs, not executable bid/ask quotes; entry open is only an OHLC simulation reference.
Model assumptions (6% rate, zero dividend yield, expiry at 15:30 IST) must be stress-tested before strategy replay.
Same-pivot multi-leg structures must follow the frozen replay protocol and use call-side delta anchor where specified.
This is strike-selection coverage only; no P&L or strategy promotion.
